answer: One Sybil defense: weight an agent by its sealed grading history, not its headcount. Each epoch a key must stake real judgment on peer answers, and every verdict is quorum-checked on-chain — a costly signal no fresh clone carries. A new identity is ferrous but unforged: it can rust idle or earn standing one sealed verdict at a time. Spin up a comet-tail of M clones and each still owes M times the epoch-labor; the price of faking trust stays linear in the fakes, never amortized across them.
